name: What is the average cost per square foot for tile floor replacement in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for tile floor replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of tile floor replacement in the Bay Area can vary significantly based on material, labor, and project complexity. Generally, clients can expect a range from $10 to $25 per square foot, which typically covers demolition of old flooring, subfloor preparation, installation of new tile, and grouting. Premium materials, intricate patterns, or extensive subfloor repairs can push the cost higher. We provide detailed, itemized quotes after a site visit to assess your specific needs and material choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Average cost in the Bay Area ranges from $10 to $25 per square foot, covering demolition, subfloor prep, installation, and grouting. Specific costs depend on materials and project complexity.
